Shortlist for a 20-person sales team:
1. HubSpot Sales Hub Starter: $20 per seat/month
2. Pipedrive Advanced: $24 per seat/month
3. Salesforce Starter Suite: $25 per seat/month
4. Close Growth: $49 per seat/month
